page.overview:
Who is Shrapnel?

Shrapnel is a minor character in Invincible.

She was a superhero and one of the many to try out for the new Guardians of the Globe roster. Eventually, she was killed in the Invincible War by Hoodvincible.

Shrapnel's body has many mechanical parts, with her left arm being fully cybernetic. Said arm has a light brown glove covering her hand but exposing her fingertips. Her right arm is identical, except with the technological part, still wearing the light brown glove. Her head has blue and white markings, with the blue surrounding her eye and the white streaking across her hair and having 4 lines on the sides of her face. Her clothing is quite basic, having a yellow vest with very light brown accents and regular pants with a belt, having two pockets along with a holster and pistol in it.

Her original whereabouts are unknown, including her powers and capabilities.
